label: GTA III ships with Chatterbox FM
detail: Lazlow's call-in show, recorded in his home studio with friends, neighbors and his father as callers.

label: Vice City adds K-Chat and VCPR
detail: Two talk stations: Amy Sheckenhausen's celebrity interviews and Maurice Chavez's Pressing Issues.

label: Wil Wheaton records Richard Burns
detail: Wheaton voices the WCTR News reporter in summer 2004, in most of an afternoon, per his blog.

label: San Andreas ships with WCTR
detail: A full talk schedule including Entertaining America, Area 53 and Gardening with Maurice.

label: Liberty City Stories: LCFR
detail: Five shows, with Chatterbox as one slot and Richard Burns calling Electron Zone Radio.

label: Vice City Stories: VCPR returns
detail: Pressing Issues, Bait and Switch, New World Order and two archive reruns.

label: WKTTRadio.com fan call-in line opens
detail: Fans leave messages on a New York number; some end up on The Richard Bastion Show.

label: GTA IV ships with WKTT, PLR and Integrity 2.0
detail: Three talk stations: right-wing, public radio, and Lazlow's looping street interviews.

label: Episodes from Liberty City add talk shows
detail: The Martin Serious Show, Conspire, and Integrity 2.0 with Jorge.

label: GTA V ships with WCTR and Blaine County Radio
detail: Chakra Attack, Chattersphere and The Fernando Show in Los Santos; three conservative shows in Blaine County.

label: J.B. Smoove on Chakra Attack
detail: Smoove tells PC Gamer the show was scripted but he was given room to play.

label: Lazlow leaves Rockstar (per Wikipedia and PC Gamer)
detail: A month after Dan Houser; VGC reported the exit on 2020-08-14 from his LinkedIn, so sources differ on the month.

label: Lazlow doubts he will be in GTA VI
detail: Said in a Nerd Reactor interview reported by GamesRadar+.

label: Houser explains why GTA has talk radio
detail: Reported from an IGN interview: talk was the cheap way to fill hours of driving.

label: GTA VI talk radio confirmed
detail: Rockstar's radio preview confirms talk radio and on-demand podcasts for Jason and Lucia.
